_comment: grid coordinate 'col,row' -> printed stage number, read off the map.
The 10x10 grid is spatial, NOT in numeric order (top-left room is
stage 41). stageByCoord is intentionally empty: the printed numbers
are small and could not be transcribed reliably enough to trust, and
the spatial overworld navigates by grid position, so rooms are keyed
and displayed by 'col,row'. Fill this in to show real stage numbers.
